rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the legal dissolution of a marriage.

example.english: They have already completed the divorce procedure.
example.traditional: 佢哋已經辦咗離婚手續。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 ji5 ging1 baan6 zo2 lei4 fan1 sau2 zuk6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for legally ending a marriage or getting divorced; add 同 + the person when naming the spouse.

example.english: I got a divorce from my spouse.
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 lei4 fan1 laa3
